_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code settings. The single hook below blocks `gh pr create` when the branch's diff vs origin/main touches any agent prompt / skill / reasoner-config file unless a verification receipt exists at `.claude/agent-test-receipts/<HEAD-sha>.txt`. Background: PRs #209/#211/#213 each claimed to fix #174/#212, all shipped untested via the actual code path, all left the bug live for ~24h. The receipt-keyed-by-HEAD design forces a fresh test on every rebase/amend. See scripts/agent-pr-verify-gate.sh for the full rationale and the agent-facing block message.
